Well, yes. If you're going to bring out a 9-cap, it had better be worth
as much as three 3-caps.

If your 9-cap looks like Crusher, it just ain't worth it. Crusher fits
in exactly one deck; the deck using his Fortitude AND at least two more
of his disciplines. In every other deck, the disciplines one seeks are
available much cheaper, and his +1 strength isn't enough to make up for
2-3 pool.

>No blocks by princes AND superior kindred coercion over a prince in
>addition to his title and disciplines seems like quite alot to me.

I bet they do, if you compare them to Marty Lechtansi. But really, how
many decks do you see Marty (quiet, Josh) in these days?

That's right. Zero. But why? Marty only lacks one discipline point
compared to Ellison, and is a Camarilla Primogen,... and had superior
Dominate to boot? Even if you give Marty superior ANI, he's still not
worth including in most decks... because while he's not a SUCKY 9-cap,
disciplines alone just don't do it at that level. You gotta have more.
Marty is worth two 3-caps, more than a lot of 9s from Jyhad. But 9-caps
take 3 turns to get... they need to be worth three 3-caps.
